# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""fetch_remote_changes.py — 把远端领先文件拉到本地镜像目录，供与工作区逐件 diff。

用法：py -X utf8 tools/fetch_remote_changes.py <repo> <ref> <本地输出根> <path1> <path2> ...
输出：<输出根>/<repo path 原样>；并打印每件 sha。
"""
import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

REPO, REF, OUT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
PATHS = sys.argv[4:]


def gh(args):
    r = subprocess.run(["gh", "api"] + args, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(r.stderr[:300])
    return json.loads(r.stdout)


os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
for p in PATHS:
    blob = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/contents/{p}?ref={REF}"])
    data = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/git/blobs/{blob['sha']}"])
    content = base64.b64decode(data["content"])
    dst = os.path.join(OUT, p.replace("/", os.sep))
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
    with open(dst, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)
    print(f"  {p}  ({len(content)}B, sha {data['sha'][:10]})")
print(f"✓ {len(PATHS)} 件 → {OUT}")
